description: This source file contains implementations of multiple large number (big number) arithmetic functions typically used in cryptographic operations, such as multiplication, squaring, addition, and division of large integers, with various platform-specific optimizations.

methods.name: BN_ULONG bn_mul_add_words(BN_ULONG * rp,BN_ULONG * ap,int num,BN_ULONG w)
methods.description: Performs multiplication and addition on word arrays with platform-specific optimization for large integers.

methods.name: BN_ULONG bn_mul_words(BN_ULONG * rp,BN_ULONG * ap,int num,BN_ULONG w)
methods.description: Multiplies an array of words by a single word, producing a result array with optional carry output.

methods.name: void bn_sqr_words(BN_ULONG * r,BN_ULONG * a,int n)
methods.description: Squares a large number represented as an array of words.

methods.name: BN_ULONG bn_div_words(BN_ULONG h,BN_ULONG l,BN_ULONG d)
methods.description: Divides a large number (represented by high and low words) by another word, returning the quotient.

methods.name: BN_ULONG bn_add_words(BN_ULONG * r,BN_ULONG * a,BN_ULONG * b,int n)
methods.description: Adds two large numbers represented as arrays of words, returning the final carry.
